sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_brush import Session, quat_to_mat
s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json')
P=s.painter; main=s.sheets['main']; downR=quat_to_mat(s.tip_down_quat())
targ=(s.target_image().mean(2)<128)
# Target skeleton centerlines in source pixels [u,v]
paths=[
 np.array([[296,671],[302,653],[306,627],[307,600],[307,575],[304,551],[299,529],[290,503]],float),
 np.array([[288,675],[320,681],[350,679],[380,671],[410,660],[440,650],[470,641],[500,630],[530,619],[560,610],[590,606],[620,606],[650,610],[680,619],[708,626],[718,612],[716,585]],float),
 np.array([[510,616],[508,590],[507,565],[508,540],[509,515],[510,490],[512,465],[512,440],[511,415],[509,390],[503,366],[492,345],[475,331],[450,319],[420,308]],float),
 np.array([[714,619],[715,600],[714,580],[712,560],[708,540],[704,520],[698,500],[690,481],[680,463],[665,449],[650,442]],float),
]
# Coordinates pixel to world using sheet raster

def xy(u,v):
 x,y=main.px_to_world(u,v); return np.array([x,y])

def arc_samples(points, speed=.015, pressure=0.014):
 pts=np.array([xy(u,v) for u,v in points]); ds=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(pts,axis=0),axis=1); cum=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(ds)]; total=cum[-1]
 # interpolation at 100hz
 n=max(2,int(math.ceil(total/speed*100)))
 d=np.linspace(0,total,n+1)
 coords=np.column_stack([np.interp(d,cum,pts[:,i]) for i in range(2)])
 out=[]
 for j,(q,di) in enumerate(zip(coords,d)):
  t=di/total
  # 10mm ramp/ taper in distance
  ramp=min(1.,di/.010,(total-di)/.008)
  z=max(0,pressure*ramp)
  out.append((q[0],q[1],0.02-z))
 return out

def sample_at(x,y,z): P.sample(np.array([x,y,z]),downR)
P.reset()
# init complete with dry brush
for si,path in enumerate(paths):
 # dip, drive brush from well towards first point, with direction set along first segment
 sample_at(-.1,.15,.027)
 pts=np.array([xy(u,v) for u,v in path]); d=pts[1]-pts[0]; d/=np.linalg.norm(d)
 start=pts[0]; approach=start-d*.045
 for t in np.linspace(0,1,100):
  p=approach*(1-t)+start*t; sample_at(p[0],p[1],.05)
 sample_at(start[0],start[1],.02) # just touching
 for x,y,z in arc_samples(path): sample_at(x,y,z)
 end=xy(*path[-1]); sample_at(end[0],end[1],.05)
P.finish()
ink=P.display_ink('main')
out=ink>=.5
inter=(out&targ).sum(); uni=(out|targ).sum()
print('synth',out.sum(),'target',targ.sum(),'iou',inter/uni,'precision',inter/max(1,out.sum()),'recall',inter/targ.sum())
# stray within 1mm
D=cv2.distanceTransform((~targ).astype(np.uint8),cv2.DIST_L2,5)
print('stray frac area target',out[D>4.51].sum()/targ.sum())
# preview bg, target black, output blue, target+output dark
vis=np.ones((*targ.shape,3),np.uint8)*248
vis[targ]=[25,25,25]
vis[out&~targ]=[220,40,30]
vis[out&targ]=[15,15,15]
cv2.imwrite('/app/output/candidate.png',vis)

# boundary map: foreground pixels adjacent to background (4-neighbor)
def edge(x): return x & ~cv2.erode(x.astype(np.uint8), np.ones((3,3),np.uint8)).astype(bool)

dtT=distance_transform_edt(~TE); dtA=distance_transform_edt(~edge(A))
def metric(B):

 p=(dtT[BE]<=tol).sum()/max(1,BE.sum()); r=(dtA[TE]<=tol).sum()/max(1,TE.sum()); f=2*p*r/(p+r)
 stray=(B & (distance_transform_edt(~T)>tol)).sum()/T.sum()

for rad in [-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3]:

import cv2,numpy as np
from PIL import Image

 A=np.load(f'/app/output/stroke_mask_{i}.npy')>=128
 D.append(cv2.distanceTransform((~A).astype('uint8'),cv2.DIST_L2,5))
for i,d in enumerate(D): print(i,'target close<=0',((d<=0)&T).sum(),'<=3',((d<=3)&T).sum(),'<=5',((d<=5)&T).sum())
# tile regions every 100 pixels list coverage nearest stroke within 3px
for v in range(280,730,50):
 row=[]
 for u in range(220,800,50):
  r=T[v:v+50,u:u+50]
  if r.sum()<10: row.append('     ');continue
  ds=[float(d[v:v+50,u:u+50][r].mean()) for d in D]
  close=min(ds)
  cov=float(((np.min(np.stack([d[v:v+50,u:u+50] for d in D]),axis=0)<=4)&r).sum()/r.sum())
  row.append(f'{cov:.2f}')
 print(v,' '.join(row))
